cards.title: The model judges, code decides
items: Jev returns probabilities for bounded questions
Pure policy functions decide whether money moves
No language model ever calls a payment API

cards.title: Nothing charged on a mismatch
items: authorization flow: content first, settle after
Publisher signs the hash of what it actually sent
Swapped content is refused before PayPal is charged

cards.title: Every refund is a PayPal refund
items: Vault purchases refund their own capture
Cent purchases refund part of the top-up
Every decision is a signed, anchored log entry
